name: 12566 · Pine Bush, NY
findings: ZIP 12566 (Pine Bush) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12566 (Pine Bush) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 12566 (Pine Bush) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
